_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the CS2D egg in https://github.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs (MIT).
name: CS2D
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: CS2D, the free top-down tactical shooter. Installs the latest game and dedicated server from Unreal Software; more settings are in sys/server.cfg.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# CS2D: downloads the game and the dedicated server for this CPU from
# Unreal Software. Settings in sys/ are added only when they aren't there
# yet, so your edits, maps and bans are kept.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

ua="raptor-egg-library/1.0 (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT

page=$(curl -fsSL -A "$ua" https://www.cs2d.com/download.php) || fail "cs2d.com can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
file=$(grep -oE 'get=cs2d_[0-9]+_linux\.zip' <<<"$page" | head -n1 | cut -d= -f2 || true)
[ -n "$file" ] || fail "cs2d.com's download page has changed, so the game couldn't be found. Reinstall to try again later."
version=$(cut -d_ -f2 <<<"$file")
case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) server=cs2d_dedicated_linux.zip bin=cs2d_dedicated ;;
    aarch64) server=cs2d_dedicated_linux_arm.zip bin=cs2d_dedicated_arm ;;
    *) fail "CS2D has no server for this CPU." ;;
esac

if [ -x cs2d_dedicated ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$version $bin" ]; then
    echo "CS2D $version is already installed."
else
    mkdir -p "$build/game" "$build/server"
    echo "Downloading CS2D $version"
    # The download link needs the id the download page gives it.
    cid=$(curl -fsSL -A "$ua" "https://www.unrealsoftware.de/get.php?get=$file" | grep -oE "get\.php\?get=$file&(amp;)?p=1&(amp;)?cid=[0-9]+" | head -n1 | grep -oE 'cid=[0-9]+' || true)
    [ -n "$cid" ] || fail "Unreal Software's download page has changed, so the game couldn't be downloaded. Reinstall to try again later."
    curl -fsSL -A "$ua" -o "$build/game.zip" "https://www.unrealsoftware.de/get.php?get=$file&p=1&$cid" || fail "The download failed. Reinstall to try again."
    curl -fsSL -A "$ua" -o "$build/server.zip" "https://www.unrealsoftware.de/files_pub/$server" || fail "The download failed. Reinstall to try again."
    unzip -q "$build/game.zip" -d "$build/game" || fail "The game's download is damaged. Reinstall to try again."
    unzip -q "$build/server.zip" -d "$build/server" || fail "The server's download is damaged. Reinstall to try again."
    [ -f "$build/server/$bin" ] || fail "The server's download has no $bin in it."
    # Settings are the server's own once they're there.
    (cd "$build/game" && find sys -maxdepth 1 -type f) | while read -r f; do
        if [ -e "$f" ]; then rm -f "$build/game/$f"; fi
    done
    rm -f "$build/game/CS2D" "$build/game/libsteam_api.so"
    cp -a "$build/game/." .
    mv -f "$build/server/$bin" cs2d_dedicated
    chmod +x cs2d_dedicated
    echo "$version $bin" > .raptor-version
fi
echo "Installed CS2D $version."

variables.description: The password players need to join. Leave it empty for a public server.
